name: CalMatters
description: CalMatters reporting on California politics and public policy. Source Articles and their Article Chunks support finding reporting and reported connections among political actors, organizations, and measures.
limitations: This is a selected collection of reporting. Completeness against all CalMatters articles is unknown.
Reported connections are not a complete record of roll calls, campaign finance, lobbying, bill text, or ballot information.
Publication dates describe the reporting, not the dates of every event it discusses. Missing reporting or graph connections cannot establish that an event did not occur.
